data.name: Basker
data.gender_notes: Basker is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vasu’ meaning to dwell or inhabit, Basker is a Hindu name associated with the gods Vishnu and Ganesha. This name is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune to the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is the preserver of the universe, while Ganesha is the remover of obstacles. Hence, Basker is a powerful and auspicious name for a baby boy.
data.etymology: Basker belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basker total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basker holds a deep cultural significance in the Hindu tradition, rooted in the Sanskrit word ‘Vasu,’ meaning to dwell or inhabit. The name carries the blessings of two prominent Hindu deities; Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, and Ganesha, the remover of obstacles. This name reflects the profound Hindu belief in the divine presence and intervention in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, Basker signifies the dwelling of the divine within oneself and the constant presence of the Gods. The name is associated with prosperity, good fortune, and the ability to overcome obstacles. This spiritual meaning imparts a profound sense of the transcendental and self-realization to the bearer of the name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Basker: One who embraces and immerses in the divine, constantly seeking Dharma (righteous path) and Artha (prosperity). The name signifies a deep longing for spiritual growth and material success, symbolically represented by the act of embracing.

On Instagram, many users have adopted the username 'Basker' as a nom de plume for their accounts dedicated to sharing their yoga practices and progress, showcasing their asanas and journeys towards inner peace. On Quora, 'Basker' is a popular pseudonym for users asking and answering questions about yoga, Ayurvedic diets, and other aspects of Hindu and Eastern spirituality. Lastly, on Reddit, 'Basker' is the handle of a popular technology subreddit where users discuss and share news, reviews, and tips on the latest gadgets and software. The name 'Basker' thus signifies a blend of ancient wisdom and modern trends, representing the timeless appeal and relevance of Hindu spirituality in today's world.
